test_title: PYST 30: Selection Post (Graduate Level) - Quant (Held On 29 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A bus starts from City A at 1:00 PM, and travels towards City B at a speed of 50 km/h. A car starts from City B at 2:30 PM and travels towards City A at a speed of 80 km/h. If the distance between City A and City B is 450 km, at what time will they cross each other?
solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Bus travels for 1.5 hours (1:00 PM to 2:30 PM) before the car starts.

Distance covered by bus = 50 × 1.5 = 75 km.

Remaining distance between bus and car = 450 − 75 = 375 km.

Relative speed in opposite direction = 50 + 80 = 130 km/h.

Time to meet = 375 ÷ 130 ≈ 2 hours 53 mins.

Meeting time = 2:30 PM + 2 hours 53 mins = 5:23 PM.

**∴ The correct answer is 5:23 PM.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Speed of Bus (SA) = 50 km/h

Speed of Car (SB) = 80 km/h

Total Distance (D) = 450 km

Bus start time = 1:00 PM | Car start time = 2:30 PM

**Formula Used:**

Distance = Speed × Time

Relative Speed (Opposite Direction) = S₁ + S₂

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d6ced15b6824d1cdb2eda2323178bf44508cf0a00b31b0ebb47331992f5ac113.png] 

⇒ Time difference between bus and car = 2:30 PM − 1:00 PM = 1.5 hours.

⇒ Distance covered by bus in 1.5 hours = 50 × 1.5 = 75 km.

⇒ Remaining distance at 2:30 PM = 450 − 75 = 375 km.

⇒ Relative speed of bus and car = 50 + 80 = 130 km/h.

⇒ Time taken to meet = 375 ÷ 130 = 2 23/26 hours.

⇒ 23/26 hours ≈ (23 × 60) ÷ 26 ≈ 53 minutes.

⇒ Crossing time = 2:30 PM + 2 hours 53 minutes = 5:23 PM.

**∴ The correct answer is 5:23 PM.**

**__Additional Information__**

Relative Speed (Opposite Direction)

When two objects move towards each other, their relative speed is the sum of their individual speeds: SR = S₁ + S₂.

Relative Speed (Same Direction)

When two objects move in the same direction, their relative speed is the difference of their individual speeds: SR = |S₁ − S₂|.

Average Speed Formula

If an object covers two equal distances at speeds S₁ and S₂, the average speed is 2S₁S₂ ÷ (S₁ + S₂).</p
